gaps.sentence: The match ___ (abandon) because of the storm, so we got a refund.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive with have to: had to be + past participle for past obligation.

gaps.sentence: He refuses ___ (tell) what to do by people he's never met.
gaps.explanation: 'Refuse' takes a to-infinitive; passive meaning needs to be + told.

gaps.sentence: The manuscript is too fragile ___ (handle) without gloves.
gaps.explanation: Passive to-infinitive: to be + past participle. The manuscript receives the handling.

gaps.sentence: The refugees ___ (provide) with blankets and hot meals last night.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + provided. Note the pattern provide somebody WITH something.

gaps.sentence: The stage was still wet — the scenery ___ (paint) only hours before.
gaps.explanation: 'Only hours before' points to the past perfect passive: had been + painted.

gaps.sentence: The winners ___ (notify) by email at the end of the week.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + notified for the plural subject 'the winners'.

gaps.sentence: Hamlet ___ (perform) almost continuously since it was written.
gaps.explanation: 'Since + past clause' requires present perfect passive: has been + performed.

gaps.sentence: The suspect is believed ___ the country weeks ago.
gaps.explanation: Believe + to-infinitive; 'weeks ago' demands the perfect infinitive to have left.
